success_criterion.text: D3 seed 1 type+target exact on probe-rules-v1 >= 0.10 above both arm A seed 1 and v3, AND no drop larger than 0.02 against arm A seed 1 on each of: frozen test type macro-F1, frozen test target exact, probe-v1 type macro-F1, human-value-01 end-to-end exact, human-value-02 end-to-end exact. Also report each seed and the three-seed mean for D1, D2, D3, the 17 field cases per system (dev only), and nothing is selected by them.
